Comeuppance.desc: Retaliates strongly against who last hurt the user.

Aqua Cutter.desc: Pressurized water cut with a high critical-hit ratio.

Psyblade.desc: This move's power increases when on Electric Terrain.

Hydro Steam.desc: This move's power increases under harsh sunlight.

Blood Moon.desc: Unleashes the blood moon. Can't be used twice in a row.

Matcha Gotcha.desc: Absorbs half the damage inflicted. May cause a burn.

Syrup Bomb.desc: Lowers the foe's speed each turn for 3 turns.

Ivy Cudgel.desc: Type changes with held mask. High critical-hit ratio.

Electro Shot.desc: Absorbs electricity in one turn, then attacks next turn.

Tera Starstorm.desc: Damages all opponents if user is Stellar form Terapagos.

Fickle Beam.desc: Shoots a beam of light. Sometimes twice as strong.

Burning Bulwark.desc: Evades attack, and burns the foe if struck.

Thunderclap.desc: User blasts by target at light speed. Boosts stats.

Mighty Cleave.desc: An attack that hits foes using moves like Protect.

Tachyon Cutter.desc: Launches particle blades at the target. Strikes twice.

Hard Press.desc: The higher the foe's HP the more damage caused.

Dragon Cheer.desc: Increases allies' critical hit ratio, especially if Dragons.

Alluring Voice.desc: Confuses the target if their stats were boosted this turn.

Temper Flare.desc: A desperation attack. Power doubles if last move failed.

Supercell Slam.desc: An electrified slam. If it misses, the user is hurt.

Psychic Noise.desc: Unpleasant sound waves that damage and prevent healing.

Upper Hand.desc: Makes the target flinch if readying a priority move.

Malignant Chain.desc: A corrosive chain attack that may badly poison.
